            zg361_p2c_record_stage_effect = { STATUS = 3 STAGE_VAR = zg361_p2c_stage_06_status }
        }
        else = { zg361_p2c_record_red_effect = { CODE = 406 STAGE_VAR = zg361_p2c_stage_06_status } }
    }
    else = { zg361_p2c_record_red_effect = { CODE = 456 STAGE_VAR = zg361_p2c_stage_06_status } }
}
